description: This file is a shell script (.sh) containing a comprehensive test suite for the 'range-diff' command, used in the context of Git version control. It includes setup, test cases for various options and scenarios, and output verification, focusing on testing differences between commits, handling of notes, submodules, patches, and different diff options.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates or outputs the OID of a given commit or object for comparison in the tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs to check for differences.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the output.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or tests Git configuration options.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes color codes in the output for verification.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets cleanup commands to run after the test finishes.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in output files.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified parameters.
